annotation.title_clean: ISO/WD 26604-1 Agricultural machinery and tractors — Safety of autonomous machinery — Part 1: Soil-Working Machinery
annotation.title_en: ISO/WD 26604-1 Agricultural machinery and tractors — Safety of autonomous machinery — Part 1: Soil-Working Machinery
annotation.summary_en: ISO working draft of a safety standard for autonomous agricultural soil-working machinery and tractors, covering safety requirements, verification and manufacturer information on residual risks. Excludes forestry, public roads, pedestrian-controlled or locally operated machinery, and self-evolving behaviour. Currently at working draft stage (20.20).
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies safety requirements and verification for autonomous soil-working agricultural machinery
Manufacturer must provide information on safe working practices and residual risks
Excludes public road operation, forestry, pedestrian-controlled and locally operated machinery
Self-evolving behaviour or logic is out of scope
Not applicable to machinery manufactured before publication
